1803. Deep Copy Array Modification

Medium

Deep Copy Array Modification

Problem Statement:

Create a class Array. The class should dynamically allocate memory for an integer array using a parameterized constructor. Implement a deep copy constructor to ensure that when one object is copied to another, both objects maintain independent memory.

The program should:

Read the size of the array.

Read array elements.

Create a clone of the original array using the copy constructor.

Modify the first element of the original array with a new value.

Display both arrays to prove that deep copy works correctly.

Description:

Read an integer n representing the size of the array.

Read n integer elements.

Create object a1 using the parameterized constructor.

Create object a2 as a copy of a1 using the copy constructor.

Read an integer modifyValue.

Modify only the first element of a1 with modifyValue.

Display both arrays:
Original: followed by modified array.
Clone: followed by unchanged copied array.

Input Format:
n
a1 a2 a3 ... an
modifyValue

Output Format:
Original: <elements>
Clone: <elements>
